status: FROZEN -- NOT RUN as a shipping decision. Adjudicated on the 2026-10-30 menu only.
filed_by: Opus session 2026-09-02, work-order §2b 'per-hour and bear-side entry study'
hypothesis: The bear side (puts) does not carry its own weight and should be disarmed or fixed. PRE-SPECIFIED by the 2026-09-01 audit (puts -$1,160), not selected after inspection.

what_the_measurement_says.puts_full_window: n=144 over 31 days, total -$1,160, per-trade -$8.06, WR 30.6%, ex-best-day -$2,661
what_the_measurement_says.puts_post_ladder: n=72 over 12 days, total -$826, per-trade -$11.47, WR 34.7%, ex-best-day -$1,691
what_the_measurement_says.calls_post_ladder_for_contrast: n=84 over 10 days, total +$3,709, per-trade +$44.15, WR 40.5%, ex-best-day +$1,692
what_the_measurement_says.why_this_is_the_strongest_candidate_on_t: Unlike the 11:xx hour gate, the put result does NOT flip by era: negative on the full window, negative post-ladder, and negative EX-BEST-DAY in both. n=72 post-ladder is also the largest sample of any candidate.

the_two_readings_that_must_be_separated_.A_direction_is_dead: the bear setup has no edge in this regime and should be disarmed.
the_two_readings_that_must_be_separated_.B_direction_is_fine_the_EXIT_is_wrong: BEARISH_REJECTION enters on trendline_rejection, whose trigger is a SLOPED line with no single price -- so its structure stop keys on a reconstructed/parallel level rather than a named horizontal one (see conviction.py:64 and the 2026-09-02 walker-fidelity work). A directional edge exited badly reads identically to no edge at trip level.
the_two_readings_that_must_be_separated_.discriminator: re-walk the put population through the production exit_manager with (i) its recorded stop and (ii) a premium-mode stop, and compare. If B, the fix is the exit, not a disarm. This discriminator MUST be run before any disarm is proposed -- disarming a direction is not reversible in evidence terms, because a disarmed lane stops generating the data that would refute the disarm.

pass_criterion_frozen: Propose a bear-side change at 2026-10-30 only if, on >=20 post-ladder trading days: puts remain negative as-traded AND ex-best-day AND cost-adjusted, AND the exit discriminator above has been run and reports which of reading A or B holds. A disarm proposal additionally requires that reading A survive the discriminator.

kill_nails.EXIT_ARTIFACT: the discriminator shows the put population is positive under a correctly-referenced stop -- then this is an EXIT defect and disarming the direction would destroy a real edge.
kill_nails.REGIME_BOUND: the put result is confined to a single directional tape; a bear tape in the window flips it (the calls-carry-everything pattern is exactly what a rising tape produces -- see the whole-engine null study, which exists to separate edge from long beta).
kill_nails.UNPOWERED: fewer than 20 post-ladder days at adjudication -- park.
kill_nails.DOCTRINE: OP-16 states both directions are ACTIVE and that direction is not a scope -- validation is. Disarming a direction is a doctrine change, not a knob, and needs J.

does_this_ship_anything: No. Measurement only. Both a disarm and an exit change are SHAPE changes, forbidden before 2026-10-30 by the work order's §0 freeze decision. Live-money arming of either direction needs J (OP-0 #1).
